create_swimmer_environment: create a swimmer control environment with a configurable number of links using the swimmer function
create_benchmark_swimmer6: create a 6-link swimmer benchmarking environment using the swimmer6 function
create_benchmark_swimmer15: create a 15-link swimmer benchmarking environment using the swimmer15 function
generate_swimmer_model_xml: generate an MJCF XML model string for a swimmer with a given number of bodies using _make_model
get_swimmer_observation: get an observation dict with joint angles, body velocities, and target vector from the Swimmer task
